items.name: Minnesota Open 2009
items.information: Even if you choose to pay the day of the competition, you still need to pre-register. Registration closes on July 5th. After that, you may be limited to the number of events you can register for. If you pay the fees online, the cost will be $3 for the first event, and $1 for each additional event. If you pay the day of the competition, the cost is $5 for the first event, and $2 for each additional event. The fees go towards the cost of running the competition, prizes, etc. Any funds beyond that go towards future competitions.

items.name: Puebla Open 2009

venue.name: [Universidad del Valle de México campus Puebla](http://www.puebla.uvmnet.edu/)
venue.address: Camino Real a San Andrés Cholula No. 4002 Col. Emiliano Zapata, San Andrés Cholula, Puebla C.P. 72810

items.information: Competition starts at 9:00 AM. Registration until May 20th is $200.00 pesos for 3 events or less, and $250.00 for 4 or more. After that day the registration is $250.00 pesos for 3 events or less, $300.00 for 4 or more. The day of the competition the cost will be $300 for 3 events or less, $350.00 for 4 or more.
